prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Image 1 is the existing pet-house button style reference. Create ONE COMPACT version of exactly this rounded gold-rim yellow button for the wardrobe. Output button shape MUST have width to height ratio 132:56 (about 2.36:1), substantially SHORTER than the reference. It will be displayed at native 132x56 pixels, so make the simple gold rim about 3 target pixels thick, smooth rounded rectangle corners, bright warm yellow face, pale lemon upper highlight and a dark-gold lower shade. Preserve the same clean glossy 2D MapleStory pet-house button family. Do not add angular/chamfered corners. The frame must be smooth and continuous with no horizontal seams, bands or extra lines across the face. Empty center, no text or symbols, no leaves or decoration. Show the entire button with a small genuinely transparent outside margin. No background, no drop shadow, no glow, no multiple buttons.
